sloka: तदेत्कथितं सर्वं यन्मां त्वं परिपृच्छसि ।हनूमतो बालभावे कर्मैतत्कथितं मया ।। ७.३६.५१ ॥
transliteration: tadetkathitaṁ sarvaṁ yanmāṁ tvaṁ paripṛcchasi ।hanūmato bālabhāve karmaitatkathitaṁ mayā ।। 7.36.51 ॥

translations.english: All that you asked me has been told, and this deed of Hanuman in his childhood has been recounted by me.
